item.title: UK eSIM: Skip Roaming Charges, 10 GB for €9.90
item.description: EU roaming plans don't cover the UK, so data there is billed as expensive roaming. eSIMPal gives you 10 GB for €9.90, valid 60 days, with 5G on EE and Vodafone. Install it in your browser before you fly, no app needed. Save this pin for your trip.
